visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary navy header `#1F3F66`; active tab/action blue `#3A86F4`; white page background; light gray toolbar surface `#F1F4F8`; table borders `#E0E0E0`; green success/download `#00A85A`; orange warning/action `#FF7A1A`; link blue `#2F80FF`; muted text gray `#8A8A8A`.
* **Typography:** Sans-serif Chinese UI font stack. Large page title around 30–34px bold; tab labels 22–24px; section title 24–28px bold; table header 18–20px bold; body text 15–17px. Strong emphasis uses bold black text.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium-density admin layout. Wide horizontal spacing, compact table rows, toolbar controls with 18–24px gaps, page padding around 28–34px.
* **Overall Tone:** Enterprise-style academic/admin dashboard with strong navy-blue branding, dense data table, filter toolbar, and modal workflow.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section Name:** Global Header
  * **Purpose:** Brand/page identity for AI reviewing module.
  * **Container:** Full-width horizontal bar, fixed height around 80px, dark navy background, centered content.
  * **Children:** Centered title text “AI 智能评阅”.
  * **Style Notes:** High-contrast white bold title, no visible left/right navigation controls.

* **Section Name:** Two-Tab Navigation
  * **Purpose:** Switch between upload workflow and review history.
  * **Container:** Full-width two-column tab bar directly under header, height around 80px.
  * **Children:** Left tab “论文上传”; right tab “评阅记录”.
  * **Style Notes:** Active tab uses bright blue fill with white bold text; inactive tab uses pale gray background with dark text. Tabs are equal width and separated by a vertical boundary.

* **Section Name:** Page Title Row
  * **Purpose:** Identify current list view and show total record count.
  * **Container:** White background row with horizontal padding; title left, count summary right.
  * **Children:** Left heading “智能评阅记录”; right summary text using muted gray.
  * **Style Notes:** Strong navy heading, right-aligned secondary metadata.

* **Section Name:** Filter / Action Toolbar
  * **Purpose:** Provide search, filtering, reset, and export actions for the table.
  * **Container:** Light gray-blue strip, full-width, horizontal flex layout, height around 85px.
  * **Children:** Search input -> result dropdown -> status dropdown -> primary query button -> secondary reset button -> right-aligned export button.
  * **Style Notes:** Controls have rectangular shape, subtle gray border, minimal radius. Primary button is blue fill; export is white with green border/text; reset is neutral white.

* **Section Name:** Review History Table
  * **Purpose:** Display review records in a structured grid.
  * **Container:** Wide table occupying most page width, aligned under toolbar, white body with bordered grid.
  * **Children:** Header row -> repeated data rows -> per-row action link group.
  * **Style Notes:** Header background matches navy brand color with white bold text. Body rows are tall enough for two-line status cells. Grid borders are light gray; text is center-aligned except document name, which is left-aligned.

* **Section Name:** Pagination Footer
  * **Purpose:** Navigate paginated table data and control page size.
  * **Container:** Left-aligned row beneath table with compact controls.
  * **Children:** Previous arrow -> current page chip -> next arrow -> page-size selector.
  * **Style Notes:** Current page uses blue square fill with bold dark text; arrows and page-size text use muted gray.

* **Section Name:** Submit-to-Instructor Modal
  * **Purpose:** Confirm submission of a selected review/report to an instructor.
  * **Container:** Floating dialog anchored over lower-right page area, width around 760–820px, white body, navy title bar, subtle border/shadow, rounded outer corners.
  * **Children:** Modal title bar -> close icon -> form rows -> footer buttons.
  * **Style Notes:** Title bar uses dark navy with centered white title “提交导师审阅”; close icon at top-right. Form labels align in a left column, fields in a wider right column. Footer buttons centered/right-weighted with neutral cancel and blue primary confirm.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Filterable data table.
* **Visual Structure:** Columns include sequence/index, document title, detection/review type, overall result, report generation timestamp, submission status, and row actions. Header row is dark and high contrast; body rows are separated by full grid lines.
* **Field Types:** Runtime rows should display numeric order, uploaded document name/file type, review category, qualitative evaluation result, generated time, submission state with optional submitted date, and available actions.
* **Styling Rules:** Document names align left and may truncate with ellipsis if long. Numeric/index and categorical fields align center. The overall result column uses tinted cell backgrounds by category, such as pale blue/green/yellow/red for different result levels. Submission status can use bold primary status text with a smaller secondary date underneath.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Table content must be populated from runtime review-history data, not from the screenshot’s example rows.

* **Pattern Type:** Row action link group.
* **Visual Structure:** Each row contains horizontally spaced text links for document download, report download, preview, and instructor submission.
* **Field Types:** Actions represent file access, report access, preview navigation, and submission workflow.
* **Styling Rules:** Use distinct semantic colors: neutral/dark for original document download, green for report download, blue for preview, orange for submit/review escalation. Links should remain inline and evenly spaced.

* **Pattern Type:** Modal form.
* **Visual Structure:** Three stacked form rows: read-only document name field, instructor selector, and remarks input/textarea, followed by two action buttons.
* **Field Types:** Selected document title, instructor option, helper text listing available instructors, optional note/remark.
* **Styling Rules:** Labels are muted gray and right/left aligned consistently; inputs are rectangular with light gray borders. Read-only document field appears as a standard input-like surface. Helper text is smaller and muted.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* Search input includes a magnifying-glass icon and placeholder text “请输入文档名称搜索”.
* Dropdown filters use bordered rectangular selectors with down-caret indicators, including “全部结果” and “全部状态”.
* “查询” is the primary toolbar action with solid blue fill and white/dark bold text treatment.
* “重置” is a secondary neutral action with white background and gray border.
* “导出记录” is a secondary/export action styled as an outlined green button, positioned on the far right.
* Table action links are lightweight text buttons rather than filled buttons.
* Clicking “提交审阅” opens the modal “提交导师审阅”.
* Modal close uses an “×” icon in the title bar.
* Modal footer contains “取消” as neutral secondary and “确认提交” as primary blue action.
* Inputs and selectors should show focus states using blue border or subtle outline; destructive/validation feedback should appear near fields without disrupting layout.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Dark navy global header, two-tab layout with bright-blue active tab, filter toolbar above a dense grid table, color-coded evaluation result cells, inline action links, left pagination, and navy-titled modal dialog.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Record count, table rows, document names, result labels, timestamps, submission states/dates, available row actions, instructor options, and modal form values.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding screenshot-specific document titles, dates, counts, instructor names, or row values as seeded UI content. Preserve only structural labels, controls, and visual behavior.

visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:**
  * Primary header/nav: deep navy blue `#1F3D5F` / `#203B5A`.
  * Main background: very light gray `#F2F2F2`.
  * Content surfaces: white `#FFFFFF`.
  * Borders/dividers: light gray `#D8D8D8`, table grid lines `#E3E3E3`.
  * Success/positive emphasis: green `#42B35A` with pale green fill `#EAF8EC`.
  * Warning/deficiency emphasis: orange `#F28C28` with pale orange fill `#FFF4EA`.
  * Recommendation/info emphasis: blue `#2F86F6` with pale blue fill `#EEF6FF`.
  * Rating cell backgrounds: soft green, soft blue, soft yellow depending on evaluation level.
* **Typography:**
  * Chinese UI font stack: system sans-serif, e.g. `Microsoft YaHei`, `PingFang SC`, `Noto Sans SC`, Arial.
  * Page title: large, bold, approx. 24–28px, white.
  * Section headers: 16–18px, bold, white on navy.
  * Table headers: 14–15px, bold.
  * Body/table text: 12–14px, compact line height around 1.5.
  * Important rating result: larger bold text, approx. 22–26px.
* **Spacing Rhythm:**
  * Dense enterprise layout.
  * Narrow internal padding in tables, approx. 6–10px.
  * Main content uses 12–16px section gaps.
  * Left preview panel has tighter margins and a framed document viewer.
* **Overall Tone:**
  * Academic/enterprise report dashboard.
  * Split-screen document review interface combining source-paper preview and AI evaluation report.
  * Dense, information-heavy, structured, formal.

---

### 2. Page Skeleton \(Top to Bottom\)

* **Section Name:** Full Page Container
  * **Purpose:** Holds the dual-column AI paper review interface.
  * **Container:** Fixed or max-width centered layout, light gray page background, subtle outer shadow/border around the application frame.
  * **Children:**
    * Global title bar.
    * Two-column workspace.
  * **Style Notes:** Overall app frame has thin gray border and slight shadow. Content is visually divided into left preview and right report.

* **Section Name:** Global Title Bar
  * **Purpose:** Identifies the page as an AI intelligent review report.
  * **Container:** Full-width horizontal navy header, height approx. 70px.
  * **Children:**
    * Centered title text: `AI 智能评阅报告`.
  * **Style Notes:** White bold title, centered both horizontally and vertically. No visible side actions in the top bar.

* **Section Name:** Main Workspace
  * **Purpose:** Displays original paper preview on the left and AI review results on the right.
  * **Container:** Horizontal flex layout.
    * Left column approx. 39–41% width.
    * Right column approx. 59–61% width.
    * Full-height content region below header.
  * **Children:**
    * Left Paper Preview Panel.
    * Right Review Report Panel.
  * **Style Notes:** Vertical separator between columns. Both columns sit on light gray background with white content areas.

---

* **Section Name:** Left Paper Preview Panel
  * **Purpose:** Shows the original document preview with paging/zoom controls.
  * **Container:** Vertical column, light gray background, fixed height matching viewport/application height.
  * **Children:**
    * Preview panel header.
    * Document filename/title row.
    * Scrollable document preview viewport.
    * Bottom document toolbar.
  * **Style Notes:** Left panel feels like an embedded PDF/Word viewer. Compact, document-focused, with the preview area framed by light borders.

* **Section Name:** Left Preview Header
  * **Purpose:** Labels the document preview area.
  * **Container:** Navy horizontal strip, height approx. 45px.
  * **Children:**
    * Small document/file icon.
    * Label: `论文预览`.
  * **Style Notes:** White bold text, centered horizontally within the left column. Icon appears before label.

* **Section Name:** Document Filename Row
  * **Purpose:** Displays the current uploaded/loaded paper file.
  * **Container:** White or very light gray row, centered text, approx. 38–45px high.
  * **Children:**
    * Filename text placeholder.
  * **Style Notes:** Bold black text. This row should be runtime-driven and not hardcoded.

* **Section Name:** Document Preview Viewport
  * **Purpose:** Displays page content of the original thesis/paper.
  * **Container:** White page-like surface inside a light gray framed viewport.
    * Outer padding approx. 18–22px.
    * Inner document page has thin gray border.
    * Vertical scrollbar visible on right side of the document area.
  * **Children:**
    * Simulated/rendered paper page.
    * Scroll hint or bottom fade area, if applicable.
  * **Style Notes:** Document page uses narrow text column, academic layout styling, centered paper title, abstract section, paragraph text. Future implementation should render real document/PDF pages or server-generated previews rather than seeded text.

* **Section Name:** Bottom Document Toolbar
  * **Purpose:** Provides document navigation and zoom controls.
  * **Container:** Fixed-height bottom bar, light gray/white background, top border.
  * **Children:**
    * Zoom out button.
    * Zoom percentage display/control.
    * Zoom in button.
    * Divider.
    * Previous page button.
    * Page number indicator/input.
    * Next page button.
    * Divider.
    * Fullscreen/open button.
  * **Style Notes:** Small square controls with thin gray borders. Compact icon-only buttons. Page indicator is centered in a bordered input-like box.

---

* **Section Name:** Right Review Report Panel
  * **Purpose:** Presents the AI evaluation report and structured review output.
  * **Container:** Vertical scrollable content column, white/light gray background, padding approx. 14–16px.
  * **Children:**
    * Top action row.
    * Basic information card/table.
    * Rating rubric table section.
    * Overall rating summary strip.
    * Comprehensive evaluation and suggestions section.
  * **Style Notes:** Right content is report-like, with repeated navy section headers and bordered white cards. Tables are dense and grid-based.

* **Section Name:** Right Top Action Row
  * **Purpose:** Provides report download action.
  * **Container:** Horizontal row aligned to the right, height approx. 50–60px.
  * **Children:**
    * Primary green button: `下载评阅报告`.
  * **Style Notes:** Button has green fill, white bold text, download icon, rounded corners approx. 4px, medium height approx. 44px. It is the most prominent interactive control on the page.

* **Section Name:** Basic Information Section
  * **Purpose:** Shows structured metadata for the review subject.
  * **Container:** Bordered card with navy section title bar.
  * **Children:**
    * Section header: `一、评阅基本信息`.
    * Two-column key-value table.
  * **Style Notes:** Header is navy with white centered text. Table has thin gray grid lines, label column narrower, value column wider. Values are bold black. Rows are compact.

* **Section Name:** Rubric Evaluation Section
  * **Purpose:** Displays evaluation by indicators, criteria, rating level, and review comments.
  * **Container:** Bordered table under navy title bar.
  * **Children:**
    * Section header: `二、分项指标等级评价`.
    * Rubric table with four major columns.
    * Overall rating summary strip below the table.
  * **Style Notes:** Dense table with strong column structure. Header row navy with white text. Body cells use light backgrounds and thin grid lines. Rating column uses colored fill to visually distinguish levels.

* **Section Name:** Comprehensive Evaluation Section
  * **Purpose:** Presents strengths, deficiencies, and improvement suggestions.
  * **Container:** Bordered card with navy section title bar and stacked colored panels.
  * **Children:**
    * Section header: `三、综合评价与整体建议`.
    * Positive summary panel.
    * Deficiency panel.
    * Improvement suggestion panel.
  * **Style Notes:** Each panel has a colored header band, matching light tinted body, and bullet-list content. Panels stack vertically with minimal gaps and rounded/bordered edges.

---

### 3. Data Presentation Style

* **Data Area:** Document Preview
  * **Pattern Type:** Embedded document/PDF preview.
  * **Visual Structure:** Scrollable page viewport with page rendering, visible scrollbar, and page/zoom toolbar.
  * **Field Types:** Runtime document pages, current page number, total page count, zoom percentage, filename.
  * **Styling Rules:**
    * Document should render on white paper-like background.
    * Maintain page aspect ratio and internal margins.
    * Toolbar state should update from runtime viewer state.
    * Text shown inside the paper must come from the document renderer, not from static UI mock data.
  * **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not seed the displayed paper title, abstract, paragraphs, filename, or page numbers from the screenshot.

* **Data Area:** Basic Review Information
  * **Pattern Type:** Key-value table.
  * **Visual Structure:**
    * Two columns: left label, right value.
    * Multiple compact rows.
    * Thin horizontal dividers.
  * **Field Types:** Person name, advisor/mentor, academic discipline, institution/department, review type, paper category/version, paper title or subject.
  * **Styling Rules:**
    * Label column left-aligned, regular or medium weight.
    * Value column left-aligned, bold.
    * Use consistent row height approx. 28–32px.
    * Keep all values runtime-driven.
  * **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not reuse screenshot-specific names, departments, document titles, categories, or institutions.

* **Data Area:** Rubric Evaluation Table
  * **Pattern Type:** Dense assessment/rubric table.
  * **Visual Structure:**
    * Four-column table:
      * Evaluation indicator/category.
      * Evaluation elements/criteria.
      * Evaluation level.
      * Evaluation opinion/comments.
    * Several grouped rows where the category cell spans multiple criteria.
    * Rating column visually emphasized with colored backgrounds.
    * Opinion column contains multiple short labeled comment lines.
  * **Field Types:**
    * Rubric category names.
    * Criteria list.
    * Rating level/category.
    * Comment labels such as basis, highlight, deficiency, suggestion.
    * Free-text review comments.
  * **Styling Rules:**
    * Table header navy background with white bold text.
    * Category cells centered and bold.
    * Criteria cells compact, multiline.
    * Rating cells centered, bold, larger than body text.
    * Opinion/comments left-aligned with compact line height.
    * Use semantic color coding for comment labels:
      * Basis/neutral: dark gray/black.
      * Strength/highlight: green.
      * Deficiency: orange/red.
      * Suggestion: blue.
    * Long comments should wrap naturally; avoid horizontal overflow.
  * **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not reproduce the specific assessment comments or scores from the screenshot.

* **Data Area:** Overall Rating Summary
  * **Pattern Type:** Highlight strip / summary badge area.
  * **Visual Structure:** Full-width pale green box with green border, centered sentence, large bold rating word.
  * **Field Types:** Overall rating level, count/summary of sub-ratings by level.
  * **Styling Rules:**
    * Use pale positive background when result is favorable.
    * Main rating text should be bold and larger.
    * Supporting count text should be smaller and inline.
    * Keep summary dynamically generated from rubric data.
  * **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not hardcode the shown overall grade or indicator counts.

* **Data Area:** Comprehensive Evaluation Panels
  * **Pattern Type:** Stacked categorized feedback cards.
  * **Visual Structure:**
    * Three vertically stacked sections.
    * Each has a colored title band and a light tinted body.
    * Body contains bullet list feedback.
  * **Field Types:**
    * Strengths/advantages.
    * Deficiencies/problems.
    * Improvement suggestions.
  * **Styling Rules:**
    * Positive panel: green header and pale green body.
    * Deficiency panel: orange header and pale warm body.
    * Suggestion panel: blue header and pale blue body.
    * Panel titles use icons such as check, warning triangle, and arrow.
    * Bullet items are compact, left-aligned, runtime-driven.
  * **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not reuse the exact bullet content from the screenshot.

---

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Primary Button**
  * `下载评阅报告`
  * Green filled button, white bold text, left icon, rounded corners.
  * Positioned at top-right of the report panel.
  * Should trigger export/download of the review report.

* **Document Viewer Controls**
  * Zoom out button, zoom percentage display, zoom in button.
  * Previous/next page navigation.
  * Current page / total pages indicator.
  * Fullscreen/open-preview control.
  * Controls should be small, square or compact rectangular, with white background, gray border, and black icon/text.
  * Disabled states should use lower opacity and muted border/text.

* **Scrollable Areas**
  * Left document preview must be independently scrollable.
  * Right report content may scroll vertically if content exceeds viewport.
  * Scrollbars should be subtle gray and not visually dominate the page.

* **Tables**
  * Not obviously editable; they behave as read-only report presentation.
  * Rows and cells should support wrapped text and variable runtime lengths.
  * No pagination is shown for report tables; the full rubric appears inline.

* **Feedback/Status Areas**
  * Rating summary and categorized feedback panels function as visual feedback.
  * Colors should be semantic and consistent:
    * Green = strengths/positive.
    * Orange = insufficiency/warning.
    * Blue = suggestions/actionable improvements.

---

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:**
  * Dual-column layout: original paper preview on the left, AI review report on the right.
  * Deep navy global header and section headers.
  * Dense administrative/report-style table layout.
  * Left panel embedded document viewer with bottom toolbar.
  * Right panel structured report hierarchy:
    * Basic information.
    * Rubric-level evaluation.
    * Overall rating summary.
    * Comprehensive strengths/deficiencies/suggestions.
  * Strong semantic color coding for positive, warning, and recommendation content.
  * Compact spacing, thin borders, and grid-based alignment.

* **Runtime-Driven Areas:**
  * Document filename.
  * Rendered document pages.
  * Page count, current page, zoom level.
  * All basic information values.
  * Rubric categories, criteria, rating levels, and comments.
  * Overall evaluation level and rating counts.
  * Strength, deficiency, and suggestion bullet lists.
  * Downloaded report file contents.

* **Avoid:**
  * Do not hardcode screenshot-specific paper title, author, advisor, school, category, or document content.
  * Do not seed the exact rubric comments or bullet summaries shown in the image.
  * Do not treat visible paper text as UI copy.
  * Do not make the layout decorative or card-heavy; preserve the formal report/table density.

FEAT-AI-REVIEW-RUBRICS.name: 评阅模板与客观检查项
FEAT-AI-REVIEW-RUBRICS.description: 系统内置学术型博士自然科学、学术型博士人文社科、专业型博士、学术型硕士和专业型硕士五类模板。\n每类模板定义必需章节和最低参考文献数量；共享客观分值为章节完整性 30 分、参考文献数量与编号 20 分、研究方法章节 20 分、结论章节 20 分、规范检测结果 10 分。\n客观分不低于 80 且无必需章节缺失时结果为“基础检查通过”，否则为“需修改”。

steps.content: 用户进入辅助评阅页。
用户打开模板选择器。
系统展示五类模板及各自的必需章节、最低文献数和共享计分项。

visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary header uses deep navy blue `#1f3f63`; active navigation and selected states use bright blue `#3b86f6`; primary action uses green `#28ae6f`; surfaces are light gray/white `#f5f6f8` and `#ffffff`; borders use light gray `#d6d6d6`; inactive step indicators use gray `#e5e5e5` with darker gray text `#8c8c8c`.
* **Typography:** Clean sans-serif Chinese UI font stack, e.g. `PingFang SC`, `Microsoft YaHei`, `Noto Sans SC`, sans-serif. Page title is large and bold around 34-38px. Tab text around 26-28px. Step labels around 20-22px. Card titles around 24-26px bold. Secondary descriptions around 20-22px gray.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium-spacious enterprise form layout. Large horizontal sections, generous vertical spacing between progress indicator, upload area, template cards, and CTA. Main content constrained with wide margins around 6% viewport width.
* **Overall Tone:** Clean academic/enterprise workflow screen for AI document review, with strong step-by-step guidance, large touch-friendly selection cards, and clear primary action emphasis.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)

* **Section Name:** Top Application Header
* **Purpose:** Brand/page identity for the AI review workflow.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal bar, fixed height around 96-100px, dark navy background.
* **Children:** Header -> Left-aligned title text.
* **Style Notes:** Title is white, bold, large, with approximately 20px left padding. No visible search, profile, or secondary controls.

* **Section Name:** Top Tab Navigation
* **Purpose:** Switch between the upload workflow and historical review records.
* **Container:** Full-width two-column tab bar below header, height around 80px. Left tab active, right tab inactive. Uses border/divider between tabs.
* **Children:** Tab Navigation -> Active tab “论文上传” -> Inactive tab “评阅记录”.
* **Style Notes:** Active tab has bright blue background with white bold text. Inactive tab has very light gray background with dark gray text. Tabs occupy equal width. Bottom border separates navigation from workflow content.

* **Section Name:** Step Progress Indicator
* **Purpose:** Show the three-step review process and current step.
* **Container:** Full-width light gray band, height around 120px. Centered horizontal progress layout.
* **Children:** Progress Indicator -> Step 1 circle + label -> Connector line -> Step 2 circle + label -> Connector line -> Step 3 circle + label.
* **Style Notes:** Current step circle is filled blue with white number. Current step label is blue and bold. Future step circles are light gray with gray border and gray numbers. Connector lines are thin gray horizontal rules. Labels sit below circles.

* **Section Name:** Main Workflow Content
* **Purpose:** Primary task area for uploading a paper and selecting an evaluation template.
* **Container:** White or very light page background, centered content with wide max width. Vertical stack layout.
* **Children:** Main Content -> Upload Drop Zone -> Template Selection Grid -> Primary CTA Button.
* **Style Notes:** Content is horizontally aligned to the same left/right margins. Large vertical spacing between the upload drop zone and template cards. No enclosing outer card around the full page section.

* **Section Name:** Upload Drop Zone
* **Purpose:** File upload input area supporting click and drag-and-drop.
* **Container:** Wide rectangular dashed-border area, approximately 90% content width, height around 200px. Background very light gray `#fafafa`.
* **Children:** Upload Drop Zone -> Centered upload icon circle -> Main instruction text -> Supported file constraints text.
* **Style Notes:** Border is bright blue dashed, about 3-4px, with slight radius around 6px. Upload icon is a blue outlined circle containing an upward arrow. Main instruction is black/dark text, bold, around 28px. Helper text is gray, smaller, centered. The drop zone should show drag-over feedback using the same blue emphasis.

* **Section Name:** Template Selection Grid
* **Purpose:** Choose one review template before starting AI review.
* **Container:** Horizontal row grid of five evenly distributed cards. Each card fixed or equal-width, around 300px wide and 190px tall on desktop. Gap around 18-22px.
* **Children:** Template Grid -> Template Card repeated -> Icon block -> Primary template title -> Optional secondary category subtitle -> Selection indicator when selected.
* **Style Notes:** Cards are white with 1-2px light gray border and radius around 10px. Selected card has pale blue background, bright blue border around 3-4px, and a circular check badge at the top-right corner. Each card centers a colored square document icon near the top, then bold title text, then optional smaller secondary subtitle. Icon square colors vary by template type.

* **Section Name:** Primary Action Area
* **Purpose:** Start the intelligent review process.
* **Container:** Centered button area below template cards, with large top spacing around 45-50px.
* **Children:** Action Area -> Primary button “智能评阅”.
* **Style Notes:** Button is wide, around 680px by 86px on desktop, green background, white bold text around 30px, slight radius around 6px. Button should appear disabled or unavailable until required upload/template conditions are satisfied if the workflow requires validation.

### 3. Data Presentation Style

* **Pattern Type:** Step Progress / Workflow Status
* **Visual Structure:** Three-step horizontal progress component with numbered circles, connector lines, and labels below each step.
* **Field Types:** Step number, step label, current/completed/upcoming state.
* **Styling Rules:** Current step uses filled blue circle and blue label. Upcoming steps use gray outline/fill and muted gray labels. Connector lines remain subtle gray unless showing completed progress.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Step labels are structural workflow chrome and may remain configurable, but step state must be runtime-driven.

* **Pattern Type:** File Upload Input
* **Visual Structure:** Large drag-and-drop drop zone with centered icon, main instruction, and helper metadata line.
* **Field Types:** Accepted file types, file size limit, selected file name, upload state, validation errors, drag-over state, upload progress.
* **Styling Rules:** Default state uses blue dashed border. Drag-over state should intensify blue border or add light blue background. Error state should use red border/helper text. Uploaded state may replace instruction text with file summary and remove/replace action.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Supported file types and size limits should come from runtime configuration.

* **Pattern Type:** Template Selection Cards
* **Visual Structure:** Single-row card selection group. Each card contains an icon, title, optional subtitle/category, and selected-state check badge.
* **Field Types:** Template name, template category/discipline, template type icon/color, selected boolean.
* **Styling Rules:** Cards use centered alignment. Text should truncate or wrap cleanly within card bounds. Selected state must be visually obvious through blue border, pale blue fill, and check mark badge. Non-selected cards remain white with gray borders.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Template list, labels, colors, and selected item should be rendered from data, not hardcoded from the screenshot.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* **Tabs:** Two full-width top tabs switch between upload workflow and review history. Active tab uses blue fill and white bold text; inactive tab uses pale gray fill and dark text.
* **Progress Indicator:** Non-editable workflow status surface. It reflects current stage visually and should update as the user advances through the process.
* **Upload Control:** Entire dashed rectangle is clickable and supports drag-and-drop. It should expose hover, drag-over, uploading, success, and error states. File picker should be triggered by click.
* **Template Cards:** Cards are selectable controls. Hover state should slightly darken border or add subtle shadow. Selected state uses blue border/fill/check badge.
* **Primary Button:** Large green call-to-action. It should be visually dominant and centered. Disabled state should use muted green/gray and reduced contrast until upload and template requirements are met.
* **Feedback Areas:** Validation or upload errors should appear near the upload zone using concise red helper text. Upload progress or selected file metadata should appear inside or below the drop zone without disrupting the overall vertical rhythm.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Dark navy header, two-tab navigation, three-step horizontal progress bar, large dashed upload drop zone, horizontal template card selector, and centered green primary CTA.
* **Must Preserve:** Strong blue visual language for active/selected workflow states, gray for inactive/future states, and green only for the final primary action.
* **Must Preserve:** Spacious desktop layout with centered content, equal-width cards, clear typographic hierarchy, and large click targets.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Uploaded file metadata, accepted file constraints, upload status, current progress step, template card list, selected template, disabled/enabled CTA state, and review history tab content.
* **Avoid:** Hardcoding screenshot-specific paper names, template records beyond structural labels, file values, dates, counts, review records, or any instance-specific business data as seeded UI content.

visual_reference.label: 全类型检测记录台账
visual_reference.analysis:
### 1. Frontend Style Direction
* **Colors:** Primary navigation/header uses deep navy blue `#1f3f63` / `#203f63`; active module/tab uses bright blue `#3b86ee`; page background is light gray-blue `#eef3f8`; table and form surfaces are white `#ffffff`; borders use pale gray `#d6d6d6` and table grid lines `#e5e5e5`; primary action button uses blue `#3b86ee`; success/export action uses green `#46c33f`; warning/download action uses orange `#e98332`; link actions use blue/green/orange emphasis.
* **Typography:** Chinese enterprise UI typography, likely system sans-serif. Page title around 28px, bold white. Primary tabs around 22px, bold. Secondary tabs and form labels around 18-20px. Table headers around 16-18px bold. Table body around 16-18px regular. Numeric warning values use stronger color and medium/bold weight.
* **Spacing Rhythm:** Medium-density admin layout. Header is tall and compact. Tabs and filters use 8-14px gaps. Form rows have consistent horizontal spacing with label-input pairs. Table is dense, grid-based, with row height around 74px.
* **Overall Tone:** Enterprise admin console for academic paper detection ledger management, emphasizing filters, batch actions, tabbed detection categories, and dense tabular records.

### 2. Page Skeleton (Top to Bottom)
* **Section Name:** Page Header
* **Purpose:** Establish page identity and application context.
* **Container:** Full-width horizontal band, fixed height around 72px, deep navy background, centered title.
* **Children:** Page Header -> Centered page title text “学位论文检测台账管理”.
* **Style Notes:** White bold title, no visible sidebar, no logo area, minimal chrome. Header visually anchors the whole page.

* **Section Name:** Primary Module Tabs
* **Purpose:** Switch between ledger records and statistics views.
* **Container:** Full-width light gray-blue strip below header, height around 64px, horizontal flex layout, left-aligned.
* **Children:** Primary Module Tabs -> Active tab “检测记录台账” -> Inactive tab “检测数据统计”.
* **Style Notes:** Active tab is deep navy filled with white bold text. Inactive tab is pale gray/white with muted gray text and subtle border. Tabs are large rectangular buttons with small radius around 5px and equal height.

* **Section Name:** Detection Type Tabs
* **Purpose:** Switch among detection workflows/categories.
* **Container:** Full-width strip, light gray-blue background, horizontal flex row with evenly distributed tab buttons.
* **Children:** Detection Type Tabs -> Active “规范性检测” -> Sibling tabs “AIGC查重”, “校内库查重”, “全文润色”, “创新性分析”, “AI智能评阅”.
* **Style Notes:** Active detection tab is bright blue filled with white bold text. Inactive tabs are white with light gray border, dark gray text. Buttons are wide, uniform height, aligned in one row with consistent gutters.

* **Section Name:** Filter Panel
* **Purpose:** Provide query inputs for narrowing ledger records.
* **Container:** Full-width light gray-blue panel with two rows of label-control pairs and one button row area, padded around 16-28px horizontally and 14-20px vertically.
* **Children:** Filter Panel -> Row 1: “年级” selector/input -> “学科专业” selector/input -> “学生类别” selector/input -> “检测类型” read-only/current type input. Filter Panel -> Row 2: “学生” text input -> “检测时间” date range inputs -> “最新检测” selector -> “学院” selector. Filter Panel -> Row 3: Primary “查询” button -> Secondary “重置” button.
* **Style Notes:** Labels are dark navy/black and right-aligned before controls. Inputs are white rectangles with light gray borders, height around 48px, radius near 0-2px. Placeholder text is muted gray. Date range uses two smaller input boxes separated by a dash. Select controls show a small downward caret. Query button is blue filled; reset button is white with border.

* **Section Name:** Results Toolbar
* **Purpose:** Display record summary and provide batch/export actions.
* **Container:** Full-width white band, height around 74px, horizontally aligned content.
* **Children:** Results Toolbar -> Left summary text showing total records and selected count pattern -> Right action group containing “导出” and “下载”.
* **Style Notes:** Summary text is muted dark blue-gray. Action buttons are large filled rectangles around 160px wide and 54px high, with bold white text. Buttons are right-aligned with a gap around 18px. The toolbar has a clear top/bottom divider from filter and table.

* **Section Name:** Data Table
* **Purpose:** Present ledger records with selectable rows and row-level report actions.
* **Container:** Full-width table, white body, dark navy header row, light grid borders, no card shadow.
* **Children:** Data Table -> Header row -> Body rows. Header row -> Select-all checkbox column -> “学院” -> “学号” -> “姓名” -> “导师” -> “学生类别” -> “论文题目” -> “检测类型” -> “检测模板” -> “错误数” -> “检测报告” -> “检测时间”. Body row -> Checkbox -> corresponding cells -> report action links.
* **Style Notes:** Header cells use deep navy background with centered white bold text. Body cells have alternating or very subtle light backgrounds and clear vertical dividers. Most cells are centered; long title/content fields are left-aligned or padded for readability. Row height is generous enough for Chinese text scanning.

### 3. Data Presentation Style
* **Pattern Type:** Filterable data table with batch selection and row-level actions.
* **Visual Structure:** A single full-width grid table. First column contains checkboxes. Middle columns display organizational, person, classification, title, detection configuration, error metric, report actions, and timestamp fields. Last columns prioritize actionable report links and time metadata.
* **Field Types:** Future runtime rows should contain institution/department text, identifier text, person name text, advisor/person text, student/category label, long paper/title text, detection category, detection template/configuration name, numeric issue/error count, report action availability/status, and detection timestamp.
* **Styling Rules:** Header text centered and bold. Checkbox column narrow. Identifier and short categorical fields centered. Long title field wider than other columns and should truncate or wrap predictably without breaking row alignment. Numeric issue/error counts should be color-coded by severity or state, using green/orange/red emphasis. Report actions should be inline text links with color differentiation, such as preview in blue, download in green, and highlighted latest/status indicator in orange. Dates/times align consistently in the final column.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Table content, counts, names, IDs, titles, organizations, and timestamps must be runtime-driven.

* **Pattern Type:** Record summary indicator.
* **Visual Structure:** Inline text above the table showing total available records and selected record count.
* **Field Types:** Total record count and selected row count.
* **Styling Rules:** Place on the left side of the toolbar, regular weight, dark muted text. Counts should update from runtime table state and selection state.
* **Do Not Copy Actual Values:** Do not hardcode the displayed totals from the screenshot.

### 4. Interaction Surfaces
* Primary module tabs: two large top-level tab buttons. Active state uses dark navy fill and white bold text; inactive state uses light surface and muted gray text.
* Detection type tabs: horizontal segmented category selector. Active state uses bright blue fill; inactive state uses white background with gray border.
* Filter inputs: rectangular fields with light gray borders, white background, muted placeholder text, and consistent height. Select controls use a downward caret. Date range uses paired inputs with a separator.
* Query controls: “查询” is the primary action, blue filled with white bold text. “重置” is secondary, white/gray with border and darker text.
* Batch actions: “导出” uses green filled styling and “下载” uses orange filled styling. Both are visually prominent and right-aligned above the table.
* Table selection: checkbox in header for select-all and checkbox per row for batch operations.
* Row-level actions: report cell contains inline action links, visually separated by spacing rather than buttons. Links use distinct colors to communicate action type/status.
* Loading/empty states: preserve the table frame and toolbar; show centered empty text or skeleton rows without changing column widths.

### 5. Frontend Requirements Summary
* **Must Preserve:** Deep navy header and table header, tabbed hierarchy, light gray-blue filter area, dense enterprise table layout, wide long-text column, colored action buttons, checkbox-based batch selection, and severity-colored numeric metric.
* **Runtime-Driven Areas:** Record totals, selected count, filter option values, table rows, numeric metrics, report status/action availability, timestamps, and detection category/template values.
* **Avoid:** Do not seed implementation with screenshot-specific names, IDs, organizations, paper titles, dates, counts, or row records. Only preserve the visual structure, labels, interaction patterns, and styling behavior.

FEAT-NORMATIVE-FORMAT-RULES.name: 默认规范检测规则
FEAT-NORMATIVE-FORMAT-RULES.description:
系统内置以下可执行规则：
- 章节顺序：摘要、关键词、引言、结论、参考文献必须出现，且按该顺序排列。
- 标点配对：检查中英文圆括号、方括号、书名号和引号是否成对。
- 重复标点：报告“，，”“。。”“；；”和连续三个以上相同标点。
- 日期格式：数字日期仅接受 YYYY-MM-DD，例如 2026-08-03。
- 参考文献：“参考文献”后的非空行必须以 [1] 开始并连续递增。
- 文本质量：报告连续重复词、Tab、行尾空格、超过 120 个字符的句子，以及规则表中的禁用词。
每条问题输出 rule_id、类别、严重程度、行号、列号、原文片段、问题说明和修改建议。

scenarios.name: 检出可重复的文本问题

steps.content: 文本包含未配对括号、“。。”和一个超过 120 字符的句子。
学生对该文本运行默认规则。
系统分别返回配对、重复标点和过长句问题，且每条问题包含行列位置。

FEAT-NORMATIVE-REPORT.name: 规范检测记录与报告
FEAT-NORMATIVE-REPORT.description: 学生仅查看本人的历史记录。列表按创建时间倒序展示文档名、问题总数、严重/一般/轻微计数和检测时间。\n报告页左侧显示带行号的纯文本，右侧显示问题列表；点击问题后滚动到对应行并高亮文本片段。支持下载 UTF-8 JSON 报告和使用浏览器打印页面。

images.label: 规范性检测历史记录与报告操作

steps.content: student01 拥有一份包含行列位置的已完成报告。
学生打开报告、点击一条问题并下载 JSON。
原文滚动到对应行并高亮，下载文件包含规则快照和完整问题列表。

FEAT-POLISH-HISTORY.name: 润色历史记录
FEAT-POLISH-HISTORY.description: 学生查看本人全文与局部润色记录，按时间倒序显示名称、档位、变更数和生成时间，并可查看差异或下载 .txt 结果。

images.label: 全文润色历史记录

steps.content: student01 和另一学生都有润色记录。
student01 打开历史页。
页面仅展示 student01 的记录。

FEAT-POLISH-LOCAL.name: 局部文本润色与差异对比
FEAT-POLISH-LOCAL.description: 页面左右分栏展示原文和结果，支持选择档位、处理、复制结果、重置和重试。相同原文、档位和规则版本的重试必须产生相同结果。

images.label: 局部文本左右分栏润色界面

steps.content: 学生已用标准优化处理一段文本，规则版本未变。
学生点击重试。
新结果和变更列表与上一次完全一致。

FEAT-POLISH-WHOLE.name: 全文规则润色
FEAT-POLISH-WHOLE.description:
支持粘贴文本或上传 .txt/.md，提供三档可解释处理：
- 基础校准：去除行尾空格、归一化连续空白、修复重复标点和连续重复词。
- 标准优化：在基础校准上，应用管理员维护的“原短语→替换短语”映射。
- 增强优化：在标准优化上，对超过 120 字符且包含分号或逗号的句子按首个合法分隔位置拆分，并记录拆分原因。
结果保存原文、新文、档位和变更列表，可下载 UTF-8 .txt 结果。

images.label: 全文润色文档上传与三档等级选择
全文润色完成信息与结果操作
带 Word 修订痕迹的润色输出

scenarios.name: 生成可追溯全文润色结果

steps.content: 文本包含重复标点、重复词和一个已配置的短语。
student01 选择标准优化并执行。
系统生成确定的新文和变更列表，每条变更包含原文、新文、位置和规则。

FEAT-QUALITY-DASHBOARD.name: 群体质量仪表盘
FEAT-QUALITY-DASHBOARD.description: 规范分=max(0,100-严重错误×10-一般错误×4-轻微错误×1)；原创参考分=100-本地总相似率×100；创新参考分=创新性量表综合分；评阅基础分=辅助评阅客观总分。\n群体页按权限范围和时间、学生、类型筛选，展示样本数、四指标平均分和分布图。某学生缺失某项时显示“暂无数据”，不用 0 分替代。

steps.content: 名下学生拥有规范、相似度和创新性结果，但暂无辅助评阅。
导师打开质量仪表盘。
系统按公式显示三项分数，评阅基础分显示“暂无数据”且不计入平均。

FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-RESULTS.name: 学生查看批阅结果
FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-RESULTS.description: 学生查看本人所有提交轮次，按时间、报告类型和状态筛选。详情页展示原报告、对应 finding 批注、整体评价、整改建议和历史轮次。\n学生首次打开已反馈结果时，状态更新为学生已查阅。支持下载包含报告摘要、批注和评价的 JSON 文件。

scenarios.name: 查看反馈并更新已查阅状态

steps.content: student01 有一条状态为批阅完成已反馈的提交记录。
学生首次打开详情。
页面展示原报告、批注和整体评价，记录状态更新为学生已查阅。

FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-SUBMIT.name: 学生提交本人报告
FEAT-REPORT-STUDENT-SUBMIT.description: 学生可选择一条或多条已完成且属于本人的报告提交。后端通过当前用户 supervisor_id 确定导师，为每批次创建独立提交记录和站内待办。

images.label: 学生报告提交与批阅结果台账

scenarios.name: 提交报告并创建导师待办

steps.content: student01 拥有一条已完成报告，本地导师为 supervisor01。
学生提交报告。
系统创建状态为已提交待批阅的记录，并为 supervisor01 创建站内待办。
报告不属于 student01。
student01 尝试提交该报告 ID。
后端返回 403，不创建提交记录或待办。

FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-QUEUE.name: 导师站内待批阅任务
FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-QUEUE.description: 导师仅查看 assignee_id 为本人的待办，按待批阅优先、提交时间倒序排列，支持按学生、报告类型和状态筛选。红点数量来自未完成待办记录计数。

steps.content: 数据库中有分配给 supervisor01 和其他导师的待办。
supervisor01 打开待批阅中心。
页面和未读计数仅基于 supervisor01 的待办。

FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-REVIEW.name: 导师在线批阅与反馈
FEAT-REPORT-SUPERVISOR-REVIEW.description: 导师可打开原报告，对具体 finding_id 添加批注，或添加整体评价和整改建议。提交时必须至少包含一条整体评价，提交后锁定本轮内容、完成待办并将状态改为批阅完成已反馈。

images.label: 导师在线交互式报告批阅界面

steps.content: supervisor01 拥有一条待批阅任务。
导师添加一条问题批注和整体评价后提交。
系统锁定批阅内容、完成待办并将提交状态更新为批阅完成已反馈。
提交记录的 assignee_id 不是 supervisor01。
supervisor01 请求该提交记录或提交批阅。
后端返回 403，不返回报告且不修改状态。

FEAT-RULE-TEMPLATE-UPLOAD.name: JSON 规则集导入
FEAT-RULE-TEMPLATE-UPLOAD.description: 学校或学院管理人员上传不超过 1 MB 的 UTF-8 JSON 文件导入规则草稿。顶层必须为数组，每项必须包含 rule_id、title、category、severity、enabled 和 message，可选 params。\n导入仅保存草稿，不自动生效；不支持从 DOC/DOCX 模板自动推导规则。

steps.content: 管理员准备了包含两条完整规则的 JSON 数组。
管理员导入文件。
系统校验字段并创建两条草稿，不改变已生效规则。

scenarios.name: 拒绝非法 JSON 规则集

steps.content: JSON 项缺少 rule_id 或 severity 不在严重、一般、轻微之中。
管理员导入文件。
系统显示具体项索引和错误原因，不保存任何项。

FEAT-STUDENT-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.name: 单学生本地质量画像
FEAT-STUDENT-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.description: 从每类业务选取该学生最新一条已完成记录，展示四指标卡片、雷达图、原始结果时间和详情链接。\n综合分仅在四项都存在时计算，公式为四项等权平均；否则显示“数据不完整”并列出缺失项。学生仅查看本人，导师和管理员按组织范围查看。

images.label: 单学生规范性质量画像
单学生论文查重质量画像
单学生创新性质量画像
单学生 AI 智能评阅质量画像

scenarios.name: 四项数据完整时计算综合分

steps.content: student01 四项最新指标分别为 80、90、70、80。
学生打开本人质量画像。
系统显示四项来源和 80 分综合分。

scenarios.name: 拒绝学生查看他人画像

steps.content: student01 已登录。
学生请求另一学生的画像 ID。
后端返回 403，不返回他人指标。

FLOW-RULE-PUBLISH.name: 学校与学院规则配置
FLOW-RULE-PUBLISH.description: 规则包含 rule_id、标题、类别、严重程度、启用状态、匹配参数和提示文案。\n学校管理人员维护全校默认规则，学院管理人员仅维护本学院规则。同一 rule_id 的合并顺序为国标默认值 < 学校规则 < 学院规则；学院重置后删除学院覆盖并继承学校值。

images.label: 模板历史、模板上传与可视化规则配置界面

scenarios.name: 学院规则覆盖学校规则

steps.content: 学校已发布 rule_id 为 TEXT-LONG-SENTENCE 的 120 字符阈值。
college01 管理员将同一规则改为 100 字符并提交生效。
college01 学生检测使用 100，其他学院仍使用 120。
college_admin01 属于 college01。
该用户尝试修改 college02 的规则。
后端返回 403，且 college02 规则不变。

MOD-AI-REVIEW.name: 规则化论文辅助评阅
MOD-AI-REVIEW.description: 基于固定评阅模板和可验证的文本特征生成辅助检查结果。系统检查章节、篇幅、参考文献数量、方法与结论章节及规范问题，主观学术质量统一标记为“待人工确认”。\n本版本不调用外部大模型，不产生专家级学术结论。

MOD-AUTH.name: 本地身份认证与会话
MOD-AUTH.description: 使用本地 SQLite 用户、密码哈希和服务端会话完成认证。系统提供四类可测试角色账号，并在本地数据中保存学生—导师—学院的组织关系。\njAccount、短信验证码、交我办和微信扫码不属于本版本实现与验收范围。

images.label: 统一身份认证界面参考

MOD-DUPLICATION-CHECK.name: 本地文本相似度与写作风险检测
MOD-DUPLICATION-CHECK.description: 对纯文本执行本地可解释检测。“校内相似度”仅与学校管理人员已导入的本地样本库比对；“写作风险”仅根据重复率、句长分布和模板短语密度输出风险提示，不声称识别 AI 生成真伪。

MOD-INNOVATION-ANALYSIS.name: 创新性量表评估
MOD-INNOVATION-ANALYSIS.description: 通过用户填写的五维度等级和证据文本生成透明可解释的创新性自评结果。系统不搜索国内外文献，不访问往届论文库，不声称自动发现学术创新。

MOD-LEDGER.name: 本地检测台账与统计
MOD-LEDGER.description: 聚合本系统 SQLite 中真实存在的规范检测、相似度检测、规则润色、创新性量表和辅助评阅记录。统计在打开页面、更改筛选条件或点击刷新时重新计算，不承诺无延迟实时流处理。

MOD-NORMATIVE-DETECTION.name: 论文规则化规范检测
MOD-NORMATIVE-DETECTION.description: 对 UTF-8 纯文本论文执行可解释、可重复的规则检测。系统支持 .txt 和 .md 文件或直接粘贴文本，单份内容不超过 5 MB。\n检测范围包括章节完整性、标点配对、连续重复标点、数字与日期的有限规则、参考文献顺序编码、禁用词典、重复词和过长句。不检测 Word/PDF 的字体、页边距、页码或页眉页脚。

MOD-POLISH.name: 规则化文本润色
MOD-POLISH.description: 使用本地确定性规则修正空白、标点、重复词和可配置短语，并用差异视图展示每处变更。\n本版本不调用外部大模型，不声称进行语义重构，不生成 Word 原生修订痕迹。

MOD-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.name: 本地论文质量仪表盘与画像
MOD-QUALITY-PORTRAIT.description: 使用本系统已生成的四类可量化结果计算质量指标，不引入新的 AI 判断。所有公式在页面中公开，且可追溯到原始记录。

MOD-REPORT-INTERACTION.name: 本地师生报告交互批阅
MOD-REPORT-INTERACTION.description: 学生将本系统内已完成的规范检测、相似度、创新性量表或辅助评阅报告提交给本地组织关系中的导师。\n“推送”指在 SQLite 中创建站内待办，不发送短信、邮件或外部消息。批注绑定报告 finding_id 或作为整体评语，不在 PDF/Word 坐标层上绘制。

SYS-DEGREE-AI-REVIEW.name: 智慧学位 AI 评阅辅助系统（ARC 可实现版）
SYS-DEGREE-AI-REVIEW.description: 面向学生、导师、学院管理人员和学校管理人员，建设一个可在当前 ARC Web 模板中完整生成、运行和测试的学位论文辅助系统。\n系统采用单端口 B/S 架构，前端使用 React，后端使用 Express，业务数据使用 SQLite 持久化。系统在本地单实例中运行，不承诺微服务拆分、校内私有云部署、高并发或弹性扩容。\n所有核心结果必须由本地可解释的规则、公式和持久化数据产生，不依赖 jAccount、短信、微信、外部大模型、校外文献库或未提供的校内论文库。

系统架构
